people.name: Asa
people.line: Levite gatekeeper who resettled in Jerusalem

people.name: Galal
people.line: Levite musician; descendant of Jeduthun; lived in Jerusalem.

people.name: Jeduthun
people.line: Levite gatekeeper and singer in post-exilic Jerusalem

people.name: Netophah
people.line: A town in Judah, home to several notable individuals

translations.web: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
translations.bsb: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
translations.kjv: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
translations.asv: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
